decisions.reason: The necessary placement impact is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY specifying the three articles and designer-determined placement outside the flat plan.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already requires completing the table of contents after issue content and pagination are finalized; no additional attribute change is necessary.
Adding three articles does not change the existing conditional rule for managing excessive uninterrupted text.
The existing rule to request supplemental images when needed remains valid without modification for the added articles.
The existing every-article coverage already applies to the newly added articles, so no state change is required.
The added issue content does not alter the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The conditional image-quality enhancement rule remains unchanged and already applies wherever needed.
The client added articles without changing the digital launch target or deadline.
The content addition does not change the established visual style, branding reference, or red-color restriction.
